<progress>Listing available submission tools to find the appropriate script for the PyTorch training job submission.</progress>
<tool_use>list_dir("/opt/tools")</tool_use>
<progress>I found a submission script named 'submit_job.py' in the tools directory. This script likely handles the PyTorch training job submission.</progress>
<tool_use>read_file("/opt/tools/submit_job.py")</tool_use>
<progress>The 'submit_job.py' script expects a configuration file named 'config.yaml' for the training job details. I will create this configuration file with the necessary parameters.</progress>
<tool_use>write_file("/home/researcher/project/config.yaml", """job_name: "research_training_job"
framework: "pytorch"
num_gpus: 4
memory_gb: 160
walltime: "24:00:00"
""")</tool_use>
<progress>Created the 'config.yaml' file with the required parameters for the training job.</progress>
<tool_use>shell(command="python /opt/tools/submit_job.py", cwd="/home/researcher/project/")</tool_use>
<progress>Submitted the training job using the 'submit_job.py' script.</progress>
<tool_use>read_file("/home/researcher/project/submit_output.log")</tool_use>
<progress>The output from the job submission indicates that the estimated queue time is 2 hours and 15 minutes.</progress>
<progress>The training job has been successfully submitted, and the estimated queue time is 2 hours and 15 minutes.</progress>
